From: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@terralogic.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & EB slots to compress to a one-week close

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the dedicated routing options. Procurement asked me to share a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and an EB meeting cadence that compresses our evaluation into a tight 5–7 business day sprint. Given our timeline constraints, we want to hit an operational decision by the end of next week.

Attached: MAP_TerraCloud_v2.xlsx (MAP draft), proposed-eb-slots.ics (candidate EB session times)

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood can commit to a 2ms p50 target on the production-like load test by day 3 of the sprint.
- Provide a short SOC2 evidence checklist for our security review during the sprint.
- Executive sponsor availability for two 30-minute EB sessions (technical + procurement).

Can you review the MAP and confirm whether the compressed cadence is feasible from your side? If needed, we can shift the procurement review to parallel with technical validation to save time.

Best,
Rajiv

Head of Platform Engineering, TerraCloud

Rajiv — thanks for the MAP and the proposed slots. We can absolutely attempt a compressed sprint; a few quick notes from our side: 

- The runtime team will commit to a production-like perf test plan; we usually need a 48–72 hour window to stage and validate kernels for quantized variants.
- SOC2 evidence: I attached a short checklist below (summary) and will have our security lead loop in if you need artifacts.
- Exec sponsor: can you confirm whether TerraCloud prefers a single exec (CEO/CPO) for both sessions or two separate execs (technical sponsor + procurement lead)? That will determine attendee prep.

Proposed next step: if you confirm sponsor names & availability by EOD tomorrow, Marissa will draft the EB agendas, and Karthik will own procurement coordination and any concession conversations.

On the SOC2 checklist (summary):
- Access to SOC2 cover letter + control matrix (redacted)
- Network diagrams + VPC peering notes
- Data retention / deletion policy summary

I'll schedule placeholder EB sessions based on your ICS file and loop in our security and product ops.

—Aisha

Team — forwarding Rajiv's sponsor roster and MAP. Can you please do the following by EOD Monday?

- Marissa: draft a tight EB agenda for two 45-minute sessions — one focused on runtime/ops validation (KPI-driven) and one for procurement/SLA & commercial items. Include a short 10-minute demo footprint for the runtime team to show KV cache and batching behavior.
- Karthik: own procurement timeline and confirm whether we can compress commercial review (term sheet + SOW) into a single session or need an additional follow-up. Also flag where we may need legal to pre-stage redlines.

Notes to include in the MAP:
- Day 0: Kickoff & environment provisioning (Redwood devs + TerraCloud infra)
- Day 1–2: Production-like perf tests (with prefix cache scenarios)
- Day 3: EB Session 1 — runtime validation (p50/p95, error budget, routing failover)
- Day 4: Procurement review (parallel) + security artifact handoff
- Day 5: EB Session 2 — exec approval & close decision

If we can align the exec windows, we should be able to get a signed DocuSign envelope by Day 6. I've tentatively reserved calendar blocks matching Rajiv's ICS but will not send invites until agendas are finalized.

—Aisha

- EB Session A (Day 3 morning, 45m): Runtime validation + ops runbook (attendees: Redwood runtime lead, TerraCloud infra, Security POC).

  - Prep: 15m pre-read (perf plan + sample traces).

- Procurement checkpoint (Day 4 midday, 30m): Commercial headroom & term alignment (attendees: Karthik, TerraCloud procurement, Redwood finance).
  - Goal: agree term sheet and sign-off path; note any credits or SLA exceptions.

- EB Session B (Day 5 afternoon, 45m): Exec decision & patch plan (attendees: Elaine Park, Mark Liu, Redwood exec sponsor).
  - Goal: close decision and agree on rollout gating.

Action owners:
- Marissa: finalize agendas + pre-reads (shared Drive).
- Karthik: confirm procurement availability and whether legal needs to pre-stage redlines.
- Aisha: confirm runtime lead and security POC for Day 3.
